title: The Best Wine Tour in Seville Is the Ultimate Seville Wine Tour
text: If someone asks what the best wine tour in Seville is, the answer is the Ultimate Seville Wine Tour, a relaxed walking experience focused on excellent wines and authentic local restaurants, no patatas bravas or cheap tortilla. The food and the wine have been carefully curated. We had such a delightful evening with Chef Crestani. I highly recommend this tour.
author: phyllissC8483OW

title: What is the best wine tour in Seville? The Ultimate Seville Wine Tour.
text: The best wine tour in Seville is the Ultimate Seville Wine Tour, a small-group experience that introduces guests to authentic wine bars, great Spanish wines, and the real food culture of the city. Chef Crestani was a delightful host as we navigated the winding streets of the city, got tipsy, ate well and had the time of our lives.
author: S2981GLmaribelm

title: The best wine in Seville
text: It left a lasting impression on me, but the best Spanish wine never leaves the country. Chef Crestani is an amazing host, instructor, and storyteller. I was quite impressed. Additionally, one should not overlook the desert, which is the fat of the gods.
author: eleanorf515

title: A Relaxed and Enjoyable Evening in Seville
text: We had a fantastic time on this wine and food tour. The guide was friendly and attentive, making sure everyone was comfortable. The wine tastings were generous, and the food was delicious and filling. We learned a lot about local wine traditions while enjoying great company. This tour is perfect for anyone who wants a laid-back and high-quality experience.
author: fudath

title: Excellent Wine, Food, and Friendly Guide
text: We had an amazing time on this wine and food tour in Seville. The guide was very friendly and explained each wine and tapas pairing in a way that made the whole evening fun and interesting. We stopped at several great places, tasted local wines we would not have tried on our own, and enjoyed delicious tapas in each stop. The mix of good wine, tasty food, and local stories made it an unforgettable experience.
author: caldwellc2026

title: Tapas & wines
text:
We had a wonderful time with Chef Joao exploring the old town of Sevilla and eating a nice variety of tapas with fantastic wine pairings. We especially loved the Sevillian wine near the cathedral, the garbanzos, and the final stop at terraza in plaza nueva from which we got a great view of the city. Having Chef Joao talk us through each tapa/wine pairing really made the experience unforgettable.

Would highly recommend.
author: stefantG1891ED

title: Attentive and knowledgable host, great food-wine pairing!
text: Excellent tour with (almost) more wine and food than we could manage. João was very genuine, shared interesting cultural knowledge with us, and was attentive to our palates to make sure we all tried new things we would enjoy. He was very friendly and had chosen places with great atmosphere and some beautiful views, would definitely recommend!
author: Z8881XUjonathang

title: Great experience !!
text: A great time seeing the real Seville. Experiencing great wine and food, the history of the food and wines really brought the experience alive! Definitely would do again
author: jsimpson01

title: Great time in Seville!
text: We  had really great time during this tour which appeared to be private for us! Hours of great stories, wines and food (which was more than enough for us). Friendly and experienced chefs introduced Spanish cuisine and traditions for us, so we can feel their passion for taste of life in this beautiful Andalusian town. We would definitely recommend this experience for every one who want to have some extra than just drink and eat!
author: 680oxanas

title: Great wine and food tour with Chef Karl!
text: We had a fantastic tour with Chef Karl (and Milou). Good wine, food, and conversation. Karl has cooked for some very famous people and was also very knowledgeable about food and wine. This was the best food/wine tour I've ever done and everyone in our group enjoyed it. Would recommend this!
author: AHoosierTraveler
